description: A trader’s 10-bin reliability diagram (predicted probability vs observed outcome rate) keyed by the opaque masked id (tid) from a leaderboard / pulse / movers / top-ROI row. Calibration is the core skill signal — whether the trader’s probabilities match reality. Completes the discovery → tid → calibration loop without needing the raw wallet. Returns bins + total resolved count.

tid.description: Opaque trader id (tid) from a masked row.

name: polyrank_get_trader_calibration_by_tid
title: Polyrank trader calibration (by masked id)
